metadata.review_policy: Primary conference or author paper pages only; summaries are mechanism-oriented paraphrases, not measured vllm-evolve results.
unexplored_mechanism_gaps: multi-tenant fairness combined with deadline goodput
preemption cost prediction from recomputation and KV residency

sources.title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
sources.summary: Introduces iteration-level scheduling and selective batching so an autoregressive serving batch can change after every model iteration instead of waiting for whole requests to finish.

sources.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
sources.summary: Introduces paged KV-cache allocation and sharing, making sequence residency and available KV blocks first-class scheduling constraints for continuous batching.

sources.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
sources.summary: Uses chunked prefills and stall-free schedules to admit prompt work without creating long decode stalls, balancing throughput and latency.

sources.title: Fairness in Serving Large Language Models
sources.summary: Defines token-cost fairness for continuous batching and introduces a work-conserving Virtual Token Counter that bounds service differences among backlogged clients.

sources.title: SOLA: Optimizing SLO Attainment for Large Language Model Serving with State-Aware Scheduling
sources.summary: Uses per-request and system state at iteration granularity to balance TTFT and TPOT SLO attainment rather than applying one fixed priority rule throughout a request lifecycle.

sources.title: FastServe: Iteration-Level Preemptive Scheduling for Large Language Model Inference
sources.summary: Combines output-token-granularity preemption with a skip-join multi-level feedback queue and explicit state movement to reduce head-of-line blocking under unknown response lengths.

sources.title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
sources.summary: Allocates just enough serving bandwidth to requests near SLO risk, updates uncertain request information as generation progresses, and uses residual capacity for efficient batches.

sources.title: Libra: Flexible Request Partitioning and Scheduling for Serving Unbalanced and Dynamic LLM Workloads
sources.summary: Splits requests at token boundaries into cooperating micro-requests and coordinates global split selection with local SLO-aware batch formation for imbalanced prefill/decode workloads.

sources.title: vLLM v0.21 AsyncScheduler implementation surface
sources.summary: Upstream scheduler code corresponding to the real plugin bridge used by this repository; applicability must be rechecked when the served vLLM version changes.

mechanism_cards.name: Iteration-level continuous batching
mechanism_cards.problem: Run-to-completion batches block arrivals and completed requests at request granularity.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Rebuild the runnable batch every decoding iteration so arrivals, prefills and completed sequences can enter or leave without waiting for an entire request batch.
assumptions: autoregressive decoding exposes an iteration boundary
scheduler overhead is small relative to model iteration time
mechanism_cards.complexity_cost: O(n log n) ordering is acceptable; avoid nested scans
mechanism_cards.resource_cost: no additional KV state by itself
failure_modes: hot-path policy overhead dominates at low load
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Change runnable-set membership at every iteration rather than choose one static request batch.

mechanism_cards.name: KV-residency-aware admission
mechanism_cards.problem: Admitting work without considering finite KV residency can trigger eviction and recomputation cascades.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Use free KV blocks, cached-prefix value and per-request residency cost to gate admission before memory is exhausted.
assumptions: KV availability and per-request cost signals are trustworthy
deferred work remains bounded against starvation
mechanism_cards.complexity_cost: one queue ordering and bounded admission pass
incompatibilities: simulators that do not expose real KV occupancy
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Add a resource-state admission branch before the prefill loop.

mechanism_cards.name: Stall-free chunked prefill
mechanism_cards.problem: Large prefills create long iterations that stall active decode requests.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Bound prefill work per iteration and reserve decode progress while using residual token budget for prompt chunks.
applicable_workloads: long prompt and active decode mix
possible_regressions: TTFT when chunks are too small
mechanism_cards.resource_cost: additional scheduler state for partial prefills
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Partition each iteration's token budget between incumbent decode and bounded prefill work.

mechanism_cards.name: Virtual-token tenant fairness
mechanism_cards.problem: Request-count fairness ignores large differences in prompt and generated token cost.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Account served token cost in a virtual counter and prioritize backlogged clients with lower accumulated service.
assumptions: fairness is an explicit objective or constraint
applicable_software: scheduler exposes tenant identity and token counts
failure_modes: fairness objective conflicts with pure short-job goodput
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Introduce persistent per-tenant service state instead of one global request ordering.

mechanism_cards.name: Per-request and system-state SLO scheduling
mechanism_cards.problem: A fixed priority rule cannot balance TTFT and TPOT as requests move through different lifecycle states.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Switch scheduling decisions using both request lifecycle state and aggregate queue/load state, prioritizing the SLO currently at risk.
assumptions: TTFT and TPOT budgets are declared
waiting age and decode progress are observable
mechanism_cards.complexity_cost: bounded state classification plus one ordering pass
failure_modes: oscillation between TTFT and TPOT regimes
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Add a lifecycle-aware top-level regime switch instead of applying one score to every iteration.

mechanism_cards.name: Iteration-level bounded preemption
mechanism_cards.problem: Long decode residency causes head-of-line blocking when all sequence slots are occupied.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: At an output-token boundary, preempt selected long-residency requests and preserve enough state to let latency-sensitive arrivals make progress.
assumptions: preemption state movement or recomputation cost is bounded
victim selection prevents ping-pong and starvation
applicable_hardware: GPU with KV offload or bounded recomputation
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Add a bounded running-to-waiting lifecycle transition that creates an admission slot.

mechanism_cards.name: Just-in-time SLO margin allocation
mechanism_cards.problem: Unknown response lengths make static deadline priorities either too conservative or too late.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Allocate only the capacity needed to keep at-risk requests within a conservative SLO margin, then refine estimates as generation reveals more information.
applicable_software: scheduler with per-request SLO and progress state
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Maintain evolving request slack and uncertainty state across scheduling iterations.

mechanism_cards.name: Micro-request partitioning and two-level scheduling
mechanism_cards.problem: Unbalanced prefill/decode phases cannot always be handled by one colocated batch boundary.
mechanism_cards.core_mechanism: Split requests at token boundaries and coordinate global partition decisions with local SLO-aware batch formation.
assumptions: KV state can transfer across instances
mechanism_cards.structural_change: Expand the optimization surface from local ordering to cross-instance request partitioning.
